translationRepairs: He was soon made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Jing Province.
He was soon made grand general of chariots and cavalry and governor of Jingzhou (Jing Prefecture).
s0026 has 涇州刺史, the northern Jingzhou (Jing Prefecture), not 荊州. The revised replacement removes untranslated Chinese from the English field while preserving the needed distinction.
There was also a guest dining with Pi on melon; (Ke xiao gua) emended: the guest pared the melon, cutting the flesh rather thick; Pi inwardly disliked it.
There was also a guest dining with Pi on melon; the guest pared the melon, cutting the flesh rather thick; Pi inwardly disliked it.
s0061 Chinese is only 又有客與羆食瓜，客削瓜侵膚稍厚，羆意嫌之; the parenthetical “(Ke xiao gua) emended:” is an editorial artifact absent from the source, and removing it leaves an accurate literal rendering.
